decision: Current disabled owned empty-clone-root extension is safe within the inspected production contract. No runtime change is requested. No spatial/frustum or arbitrary half-mesh filter is implemented or approved by this audit.
sourceAndLodContract: Only descendants of each newly instantiated placement are registered as empty clone roots. Original container sources and source LODs are not registered.
Only native Mesh roots with no geometry, material, submeshes, skeleton, morph manager, thin instances or action manager and native methods may be skipped, only while actually disabled.
All enabled roots, geometry-bearing sources/LODs, dynamic and quest actors retain original provider order. Geometry/material/behavior attachment immediately fails open.
Native instance preActivate and per-render-pass visible instance storage remain untouched; actual before/after source preActivate traces are identical.
Shadow selection and native shadow renderList remain independent of camera frustum; offscreen casters remain eligible under existing policy.
whyBroadFrustumIsUnapproved: Native scene skips frustum tests for scene._skipFrustumClipping or mesh.alwaysSelectAsActiveMesh. A naive prefilter could discard native-visible objects.
Main camera absence is not absence from shadow, RTT or secondary camera passes. Do not reuse a primary-camera filtered list for those passes.
Invisible geometry sources may still own visible native instance/LOD batches; source isVisible=false is not proof that its instances have no rendering work.

getLOD/preActivate reset visibleInstances and cache state before native drawing. Excluding source meshes needs actual batch equality across camera return and LOD changes, not only static active counts.
Cave camera can render using temporarily constrained transforms. Cached pre-collision world planes or approximate placement/cell bounds can reject native-visible geometry.
Skinned/morphed or custom LOD/frustum/action objects can require preparation even when a bounding guess is outside; current empty-root contract excludes these classes.
diagnosticWrapperReview: Sampling one frame at1Hz while collecting is reasonable only with clear sampled CPU/inclusive labels; it cannot identify GPU elapsed time or driver wait.
Return values, receiver, exceptions and original own descriptors must be preserved, including methods inherited from the prototype.
Pause/disposal/error/context loss must release hooks, and a retained external wrapper must become an unmeasured passthrough.

Previously reported nonconfigurable+writable descriptor issue is fixed by skipping nonconfigurable own methods; independent sampler lifecycle11focused regressions and50roundtrips passed. See audit-sampler-lifecycle.json.
limitations: Actual Babylon9.31 CPU draw/batch/LOD/shadow and source-preActivate paths, with native per-render-pass instancing storage, were exercised in NullEngine.
No GPU/WebGL driver, browser pixels, phone FPS or thermal result is measured.
A smaller candidate count alone does not prove visual equality. Actual native draws were nonzero at every stage in this probe.
